_README: Single source of truth for the 3D classroom world. Read by scripts/mc/*.mjs (via fs) and by the React side (via resolveJsonModule). Change `world.slots` and rerun `npm run mc:assets` to regenerate the school; event names are bound at runtime and never baked into the world.
